mathematicalReview.proposedNormalEquations: With fixed routes, A^T W A is positive diagonal on occupied leaves and B^T V B is a positive-semidefinite graph Laplacian. Positive endpoint mass therefore makes their sum SPD in exact arithmetic. RHS A^T W R+B^T V q has the correct signs and dimensions.
mathematicalReview.sameLeafLimit: A same-leaf pair has a zero incidence row, so its relaxed response term cannot be changed by adjusting that one shared constant. The plan correctly limits this to the fixed-route, unquantized relaxation.
mathematicalReview.splitSearch: Ranking splits by the globally refitted coupled objective is the correct declared target. Independent leaf means are not its optimizer. Greedy search remains non-global and finite FP32/BF16 admission can reverse a relaxed improvement.
